dft_code.name: Open-source plane-wave DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT, or equivalent)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT code that supports GGA, ultrasoft pseudopotentials, geometry relaxation, and dielectric function (optical properties) calculation is suitable.

dft_code.notes: The paper used the proprietary code CASTEP. This task is designed to be completed with an equivalent open-source alternative.

pseudopotentials.name: Ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Pb, W, and O

access.notes: Example: The SSSP library. Any standard pseudopotential library that provides GGA-compatible ultrasoft pseudopotentials for the required elements is acceptable.

pseudopotentials.notes: A plane-wave cutoff energy of ~340 eV was used in the original work and should be respected.

pwo_structure.name: PbWO4 crystal structure (scheelite, I4_1/a)

access.notes: Lattice parameters and atomic positions are available from public crystallographic databases (e.g., ICSD) or published literature on the scheelite structure of PbWO4. The agent must construct the supercell model from the known unit cell.

pwo_structure.notes: The supercell contains 16 Pb, 16 W, and 64 O atoms. The defect supercell has one centered Pb replaced by a vacancy.
